title: GitFocus tab: branch-first rows
overview:
This merge changes each worktree row in the GitFocus tab: the row starts with the branch, the directory name is in a right column, and the full path is in the tooltip.

## 1. Row text

- [`rowText`](src/main/kotlin/dev/gitfocus/worktrees/WorktreesList.kt:20-28) makes the text of a row. It does not use the directory name now. Before this change, the text was `name [branch]`.
- [This line](src/main/kotlin/dev/gitfocus/worktrees/WorktreesList.kt:21) gives the branch. When the branch is null or blank, it gives the `(detached)` text.
- [The `(main)` marker](src/main/kotlin/dev/gitfocus/worktrees/WorktreesList.kt:22) and [the status suffix](src/main/kotlin/dev/gitfocus/worktrees/WorktreesList.kt:23-27) come after the branch, as before.

## 2. Right column

- [The renderer](src/main/kotlin/dev/gitfocus/worktrees/WorktreesPanel.kt:412) puts the directory name in the right label. Before, this label showed the full path.
- [The right label](src/main/kotlin/dev/gitfocus/worktrees/WorktreesPanel.kt:390) has right alignment. [The panel](src/main/kotlin/dev/gitfocus/worktrees/WorktreesPanel.kt:398) puts it in the CENTER area. Thus, the name moves to the right edge when you make the tool window wider.
- A window that has no worktree shows [no text](src/main/kotlin/dev/gitfocus/worktrees/WorktreesPanel.kt:419) in the right column now.

## 3. Tooltip

- [`getToolTipText`](src/main/kotlin/dev/gitfocus/worktrees/WorktreesPanel.kt:105-107) shows the full path above the double-click hint. On the X, the tooltip is "Close this window", as before.
- [`pathAt`](src/main/kotlin/dev/gitfocus/worktrees/WorktreesPanel.kt:268-273) finds the row below the mouse pointer. [This check](src/main/kotlin/dev/gitfocus/worktrees/WorktreesPanel.kt:271) stops a tooltip below the last row.
- [`rowTooltip`](src/main/kotlin/dev/gitfocus/worktrees/WorktreesList.kt:34-37) makes the HTML text. It escapes the path and the hint. Thus, a `<` or a `&` in a path shows correctly.

## 4. Speed search

- [Speed search](src/main/kotlin/dev/gitfocus/worktrees/WorktreesPanel.kt:131) adds the directory name and the full path to the row text. Thus, you can still find a row by its directory name.

## 5. Text resources

- The new key `worktrees.row.detached` is in [English](src/main/resources/messages/GitFocusBundle.properties:217), [Japanese](src/main/resources/messages/GitFocusBundle_ja.properties:208), [Korean](src/main/resources/messages/GitFocusBundle_ko.properties:208), [Polish](src/main/resources/messages/GitFocusBundle_pl.properties:210), [Russian](src/main/resources/messages/GitFocusBundle_ru.properties:208) and [Chinese](src/main/resources/messages/GitFocusBundle_zh_CN.properties:208).
- [This helper](src/main/kotlin/dev/gitfocus/worktrees/WorktreesPanel.kt:348) reads the key for the renderer and for speed search.

## 6. Tests and manual checks

- [The row text test](src/test/kotlin/dev/gitfocus/worktrees/WorktreesListTest.kt:96-99) makes sure that the text is the branch only.
- [The detached test](src/test/kotlin/dev/gitfocus/worktrees/WorktreesListTest.kt:101-104) makes sure that a null branch and a blank branch both show `(detached)`.
- [The main checkout test](src/test/kotlin/dev/gitfocus/worktrees/WorktreesListTest.kt:106-110) makes sure of the order: branch, `(main)`, status.
- [The tooltip test](src/test/kotlin/dev/gitfocus/worktrees/WorktreesListTest.kt:112-115) makes sure of the HTML escape and of the hint-only result.
- The smoke checklist has new text for [the Alt+Shift+W item](docs/smoke-checklist.md:229-232) and for [the tool window items](docs/smoke-checklist.md:517-526).

## 7. Open items

- The unit tests do not examine the renderer or `pathAt`, because they are Swing code. Do [the smoke items](docs/smoke-checklist.md:517-526) manually.
- A window with no worktree does not show its path in the row now. Only the tooltip shows it. Make sure that this is the behavior you want.
- This commit does not cut long branch names. Later commits do this (`a3d7137` and the fix `b434be1`).

annotations.summary: A null branch and a blank branch both show the detached text.
annotations.rationale: Git can give a blank branch for a detached HEAD. The `isNotBlank` check makes sure that the row never starts with an empty text.

annotations.summary: The function escapes the path and the hint before it puts them in HTML.
annotations.rationale: A directory name can contain `<` or `&`. Without the escape, Swing reads these characters as HTML and the tooltip shows incorrect text.

annotations.summary: Speed search adds the directory name and the full path to the row text.
annotations.rationale: The row text has no directory name now. Without this line, you cannot find a row by its directory name.

annotations.summary: This check stops a tooltip when the pointer is below the last row.
annotations.rationale: `locationToIndex` gives the nearest row, also when the pointer is in the empty area below the list. The cell bounds check makes sure that the pointer is on the row.

annotations.summary: The right label is in the CENTER area, so it gets all the free width.
annotations.rationale: Together with the right alignment on line 390, the name stays at the right edge, before the X column, at all tool window widths.

annotations.summary: A window with no worktree shows no text in the right column now.
annotations.rationale: Before, this column showed the full path. Now only the tooltip shows the path for this type of row.

annotations.summary: This assert uses a blank branch, not a null branch.
annotations.rationale: It makes sure that the `isNotBlank` check in rowText works.
